about_the_game:
In this world full of magic and adventure, the homes of the beauties are under siege by zombies from another dimension! Only your wit and courage can help them resist this evil force and save their homes!

Game Features:


1. Unique Tower Defense Gameplay: "Battle of Beauties vs Zombies" creates a brand new tower defense gaming experience, combining beautiful girl characters with thrilling combat gameplay, immersing you in endless battles!

2. Diverse and Colorful Beauties: From innocent and cute to mysteriously enchanting, the game offers a variety of beautiful girl characters for you to choose from. Each character possesses unique skills and abilities to help you achieve victory in battle!

3. Home Defense Battles: In the homes of the beauties, you will engage in intense defense battles against the zombies! Set up your defense towers, summon beauty warriors, and fend off the endless horde of zombies to protect the beauties' homes from harm!

4. Mighty Boss Challenges: As the game progresses, you will face various forms of powerful bosses, each with unparalleled strength and abilities. Only your wit and courage can defeat them!

5. Equipment and Skill Upgrade System: Collect resources, upgrade your beauty characters and defense facilities, unlock powerful skills and equipment, and create your invincible lineup!

6. Diverse Game Modes: In addition to the classic level mode, the game also offers survival mode, competitive mode, and other challenging modes to meet the needs of different players!

7. Social Interaction and Cooperation: Invite friends to join the battle, build the strongest beauty team together, and resist the invasion of zombies to win victory!

Are you ready for the most exciting battle between beauties and zombies? Join us and save these beauties' homes!
